question: What are the Six pillars of iman??
choice1: <Belief in Allah, angels, prophets, holy books, prayer, and fasting>
choice2: <Belief in Allah, angels, holy books, messengers, the Last Day, and Qadar (divine decree)>
choice3: <Belief in the Quran, Hadith, zakat, Ramadan, prophets, and hajj>
choice4: <Belief in Allah, the five pillars, Jannah, Jahannam, angels, and the Quran>
